# Synthetic show sources

Original CC0 test fixtures generated by `generate.py`; no real private flyer or event.
The text is deliberately synthetic. `artistic.png` has rotated, low-contrast text and no
full year; `illegible.png` adds severe downsampling/blur. They test honest incomplete
coverage, not perfect OCR or a concert-correctness score.

Regenerate with Pillow and Debian `fonts-dejavu-core`, then run the focused OCR cases
with Tesseract 5 and the `eng`/`spa` language packages. The font binary is not distributed.
The checked CPU/PSM comparison is in `docs/technical/crate-show-ocr-evaluation.json`.
